content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge is assessing a collision on the Isaiah 7:14 link by matching one side's wording answer against the other side's application answer, so K-C's chain-vs-chain method governs.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; two readings weighed: one reading permits splitting the link into wording versus application and calling it underdetermined, the other requires weighing the opposing chains together by footing.", "why": "It declares the Isaiah 7:14 link underdetermined by separating the challenger's wording answer from the defender's application answer instead of weighing the opposing chains by footing as K-C requires."}
